name: public-bits-to-binders-interface-sequence
hypothesis: Adding binder pLDDT failed the ROC and precision guards despite a positive pooled signal diagnostic. Test a distinct sequence-plausibility mechanism: average baseline interface confidence and ESM2 binder likelihood. Sequence plausibility may identify expressible binders that a geometric interface score misses. Their discovery correlation is -0.126. Keep physical directions and equal normalized weights; pooled AUC is not assumed to transfer across teams.
